m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Oh, strange Wizard. Are you looking for our host? She's meditating in the next Clearing.
You're back. I assume you noticed our patient has recovered. Did you find your friend?
Oh, they did indeed, mada.... whaaaa. You!
You!
Wizard, you didn't tell me your new Nimbari friend was... Sparck's mother. Bring him down; let's arrange a reunion!
You travel with Sparck? He's in Empyrea? The one comfort I had all these years in exile was that he was safe and you brought him back here?
It's okay, he's still safe. He's in Nimbus now with the Vicereine and Vanitus.
You left him with Vanitus? You're in league with Vanitus? I was wrong to help you. And now I will correct that mistake.
Lady Helena, please listen to me. We did as you asked. We took Sparck and Ione away from Empyrea. She's safe now, back at the Arcanum.
But Sparck volunteered to return, to help in our mission to save the whole Spiral from Grandfather Spider and the Cabal.
Cabal? You left my son with Vanitus and you expect me to believe you're fighting the Cabal? Don't you realize Vanitus IS the Cabal?
He's what? Helena, wait... there's been a terrible misunderstanding.... We had no idea...
Does this pig speak truly? You're Lady Helena, Praetor of the Justicaria and lost wife to the traitor Keras?
I am Lady Helena. But I am not lost and Keras was no traitor.
But he destroyed himself in an explosion, trying to sabotage our weapons, our edict from Raven. It was by his example the Dark Cloud was founded.
The Dark Cloud isn't real; it's a front for the Cabal, for Vanitus apparently. They're scaring the Nimbari into making some kind of Storm Cannon.
Vanitus, you say? My Exemplar was suspicious of him too; a mere technologist having such influence on the Vicereine is not normal.
And those suspicions, foolishly voiced, are what got your squad sent into that ambush. To challenge Vanitus is to lose. Believe me, I know.
Mine is a hard story to tell, Wizard. But perhaps it's time. It begins the day my husband Keras and his friend Vanitus first saw the Spiral.
The Nimbari must be warned about the Admiral and his Cabalist underlings. Oh, but you say there's a wounded Justicar nearby you need to check on?
And a mysterious Nimbari woman who helped you find me? How... intriguing.
Okay, Wizard, you head there. I'll tie up these defeated Cabalists and meet you.
Don't worry, these Cabalists aren't escaping. You just find your new Nimbari friends.
